title: Lake camp jobs and guitarists of the Superior and Imperial bands
summary: The all-night camp jobs, and who played guitar, drums and bass in the Superior, Imperial, Olympia and McNeil bands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. What's that place where a friend of them used to play out at Mellon Boyd?

Play out there on Saturday and Sunday. That was an all night job. So I had four clubs, even at four in the morning. What's the name of that place? Fred's band was the oldest band played out there. It was out on one of the camps over the water. No it was right off the boat by the train running. You know? What's the name of that place? What's the name of that place? Was the place open to the public? Because when, I remember when Jordan Rovershoe band broke up, Jordan went playing violin with Freddie. Remember that? Uh huh.
And there's something else in one place.
Who was the, who was the guitar player in the superior band? Was he named Baptiste? Baptiste, uh, René Baptiste. Yeah. And who was the guitar player in the imperial band? Joe Brooks.
René Baptiste was in the imperial band.
No, René Baptiste, yeah, imperial band, René Baptiste, he was the managing band.
Yeah. There was a fellow named Payne in one of those bands.
Richard Payne was with the superior band. Richard Payne was with the superior band. The superior band. Billy Marrera.

You see, Billy was in the superior band, in the superior band. Johnny Leonard was in the Olympic band, see? And Jimmy Brown. Jimmy Brown's imperial band. Imperial band. I was in the McNally band. That's your downtown bass place, see? How was Jimmy Brown? What kind of a player did you play? Very good bass player. Ben Loewy.
Yeah. He was always very sickly. Sickly fellow. Very sickly.

Because… He was the best of him. Yeah. See that. Go ahead and have to turn it off here. Uh, out of Nolenburg, I believe. Oh yeah, I was trying to think about… I can't think of the name of that player. That's alright anyway, we know there were a lot of camps out there.
You see, when I went back home this time, I didn't go out there.
She said I want to go out there.
